اعتزلوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلُوا (iʕtazalū) /iʕ.ta.za.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلُوا (uʕtuzilū) /uʕ.tu.zi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اِعْتَزِلُوا (iʕtazilū) /iʕ.ta.zi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
